name: reverse
description:
The phrase backwards.

what: "chars" — its characters («абв 12» → «21 вба»); "words" — its words, joined by one space («купить диван москва» → «москва диван купить»).

Example: semkit read --text "абв 12" reverse write -
-> 21 вба
Example: semkit read --text "купить диван москва" reverse --what words write -
-> москва диван купить

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --what
options.description: "chars" — its characters («абв 12» → «21 вба»); "words" — its words, joined by one space («купить диван москва» → «москва диван купить»).

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
